label: GitHub
description: Runs one GitHub operation on issues: create, get, list, comment, edit labels or close. The result becomes the task output.

inputs.name: repository
inputs.label: Repository
inputs.description: owner/name; the calling repository when empty

inputs.name: issue
inputs.label: Issue number
inputs.description: For every operation on one issue

inputs.name: body
inputs.label: Body
inputs.description: Markdown text of the issue or of the comment

inputs.name: labels
inputs.label: Labels
inputs.description: Comma-separated labels to set, add or filter by

inputs.name: limit
inputs.label: Limit
inputs.description: Most issues list-issues returns, from 1 to 100

secrets.name: github_token
secrets.description: Token for operations that change something, such as the caller's GITHUB_TOKEN with issues: write or a GitHub App token

outputs.name: output
outputs.description: The whole task output as compact JSON, empty when larger than 32 KiB
